title: Uniform Race: Parameter-Free Approximate Rejection Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2609.34639v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Consider the approximate sampling problem: given $N$ independent samples from a proposal distribution $\mu$, the goal is to select one whose distribution is close to a target $\pi$ specified only up to a normalizing constant. The seminal work of Block & Polyanskiy (2023) provides a total variation (TV) error bound for approximate rejection sampling (RS) as a function of the algorithm's acceptance threshold $M$. The ideal threshold $M$ that minimizes the bound, however, depends on properties of $(\pi, \mu)$ that are typically unavailable from the observed sample. This raises a natural question: Can one attain the best RS guarantee without taking the best $M$ as input? We answer this question affirmatively by proposing a parameter-free sampling algorithm called uniform race (UR). translated_title: 均匀竞赛：无参数的近似拒绝采样
translated_abstract: 考虑如下近似采样问题：给定来自提议分布 μ 的 N 个独立样本，目标是选出其中一个，使其分布接近目标分布 π，而 π 仅在相差一个归一化常数的意义下给定。Block 与 Polyanskiy（2023）的开创性工作给出了近似拒绝采样（RS）关于算法接受阈值 M 的全变差（TV）误差界。然而，使该界最小化的理想阈值 M 依赖于 (π, μ) 的性质，而这些性质通常无法从观测样本中获得。这引出一个自然的问题：能否在不以最优 M 作为输入的情况下获得最优的拒绝采样保证？我们通过提出一种称为 uniform race（UR）的无参数采样算法对此给出了肯定的回答。UR 为每个样本 y 计算一个得分，该得分是重要性权重 π(y)/μ(y) 除以一个独立的均匀随机变量，然后返回得分最……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需任何参数调节的“均匀竞赛（Uniform Race）”近似拒绝采样算法，通过将重要性权重除以独立均匀随机变量构造得分并选取样本，在不知道理想接受阈值的情况下自动达到最优的拒绝采样全变差误差保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Uniform Race (UR), a parameter-free approximate rejection sampling algorithm that scores each sample by its importance weight divided by an independent uniform random variable, thereby automatically attaining the optimal rejection sampling total variation guarantee without requiring the ideal acceptance threshold as input.
